tagline: The World's Largest Equipment Rental Company
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver of organic rental revenue growth, combining utilization rates, rental rates, and equipment mix. It is the central lever of the company's profitability strategy.

kpis.name: Fleet Productivity
kpis.explanation: Measures fleet efficiency by combining rental rates, utilization rates, and equipment mix.
kpis.description: Fleet productivity increased by 2.2% in 2025, driven by improved pricing and utilization management.
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth in rental revenue

kpis.name: Rental Revenue
kpis.description: Rental revenue increased by 6.0% in 2025, supported by pricing strategy and customer mix.

kpis.name: Key Accounts Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of rental revenue derived from large accounts managed by a single point of contact.
kpis.description: 69% of rental revenue comes from key accounts, enhancing customer loyalty and revenue predictability.

kpis.name: Original Equipment Cost
kpis.explanation: Total initial purchase value of all rental equipment.
kpis.description: The fleet reached $22.5 billion in original equipment cost, up 3.9%, supported by strategic acquisitions.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is not specified in the provided documents.

kpis.name: R&D (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: No R&D data available; the company is not technology-focused in the traditional sense.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: Capex amount is not mentioned in the excerpts.

kpis.name: Fleet Productivity
kpis.explanation: Measures fleet efficiency by combining rental rates, utilization rates, and equipment mix.
kpis.description: Fleet productivity is improving due to better pricing and equipment mix management.

kpis.name: Key Accounts Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of rental revenue derived from large accounts managed by a single point of contact.
kpis.description: Key accounts mix remains high, reflecting a targeted customer strategy.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenus totaux consolidés de United Rentals toutes lignes confondues (location, ventes, services).
kpis.description: Total revenue reached $16.1 Bn in 2025, up from $15.3 Bn in 2024 and $14.3 Bn in 2023. Growth is driven by equipment rental and the Yak acquisition.

kpis.name: Equipment Rental Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Marge brute sur la ligne de revenus de location d'équipements, principale source de revenus d'URI.
kpis.description: Equipment rental gross margin declined 190 bps to 38.0% in 2025, driven by inflation, rising delivery costs, and dilution from the Yak acquisition in the Specialty segment.

kpis.name: SG&A as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Ratio des frais de vente, généraux et administratifs rapportés au chiffre d'affaires total, indicateur d'efficacité opérationnelle.
kpis.description: SG&A ratio remained near flat at 10.8% of revenue in 2025 (vs 10.7% in 2024 and 2023), reflecting good control of fixed costs despite growth in sales headcount and IT expenses.

kpis.name: Net Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Coût net de la dette financière d'URI, reflet du niveau d'endettement et des conditions de marché sur les taux variables.
kpis.description: Net interest expense increased to $716 M in 2025 (+3.6%), as lower floating rates (5.4% vs 6.3% in 2024) were offset by higher average debt outstanding. Includes bridge financing fees related to the terminated H&E acquisition.

kpis.name: Specialty Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Part du segment Specialty dans le chiffre d'affaires total, indicateur de diversification et de montée en puissance des activités à plus forte valeur ajoutée.
kpis.description: The Specialty segment represented $5.1 Bn of $16.1 Bn total revenue in 2025 (≈31.7%), up from 29.3% in 2024 and 25.4% in 2023, driven by the Yak acquisition and strong demand for specialized solutions.

risks.title: High Leverage and Financial Vulnerability
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, with $14.2 billion in debt. The language emphasizes existential consequences: restricted flexibility, default risk, and cash flow impact. Compared to the prior year, the proportion of variable-rate debt (29%) increases sensitivity to interest rates. The 'Capital' category is highly weighted here.

risks.title: Sensitivity to Economic Conditions and Markets
risks.score_rationale: This risk is extensively discussed, with past and future impacts on revenue and margins. The text cites major factors such as construction activity, inflation, interest rates, and health crises. The language is repetitive and alarming, indicating systemic exposure. The 'Macro' category is critical for the sector.

risks.title: Intense Competition in Equipment Rental
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned as affecting volumes and pricing. The industry is described as 'highly fragmented and competitive.' The language indicates ongoing margin pressure. Less existential than leverage, but structural.

risks.title: Volatility in Oil and Gas Prices
risks.score_rationale: The risk is recurring and tied to demand in energy sectors. The text highlights sensitivity to prices and long-term price expectations. While partially covered under other macro risks, its sector-specific impact is significant.

risks.title: Risks Related to Restrictive Financial Covenants
risks.score_rationale: The risk is detailed with severe consequences: credit line termination, accelerated repayment. The interest coverage ratio threshold is closely monitored. The language is technical but alarming. Less broad than overall leverage, but critical if triggered.

risks.title: Rising Fuel Costs
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned as affecting fleet mobility, a competitive advantage. Although hedging is used, prolonged increases could impact results. The language is concerned but not alarmist. Less central than other risks.

ai_positioning.summary: The company URI does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
